verdict.text: Seychelles pledges a 26.4% reduction by 2030 against 2030 business-as-usual (condition not read). The registry's current submission for this Party is NDC 3.0, filed 2025-09-30. It was read and refused, so the figure above comes from the First NDC (2021). 48 observed values are loaded from DS-02 (11), DS-35 (35), DS-40 (2). For 2024 the sources disagree: DS-02 1.5 MtCO₂e, DS-35 0.8 MtCO₂e. They are on different inventory scopes and the engine does not reconcile them. No implementation gap is reported: the pledge is 26.4% below a business-as-usual projection for 2030. That projection is not in any source loaded here, so the percentage cannot be turned into a tonnage and the trend cannot be judged against it. It submitted BTR1. 3 of 8 components have been confirmed in the document; the rest are unparsed, which is not a finding against the country. ND-GAIN scores it 48.7 for 2024. In the first NDC round, WRI's CAIT assessment recorded: 122.5 KtCO2e (or 21.4%) reduction in 2025 and 188 ktCO2e (or 29.0%) reduction in 2030 in GHG emissions compared to baseline projections It was classed partial. That is a 2016 assessment of an earlier submission, not the target above. Projected warming for 2080-2099 against 1995-2014 ranges from +0.86°C under SSP1-2.6 to +3.26°C under SSP5-8.5. These are model runs, not observations.
